scope_limit: Sophia Research is currently bounded to preparing and reviewing supplied research questions, claims, source-support mappings, citation records and declared gaps for authorised human research review. It does not establish scientific truth, approve research ethics, accept a publication, determine authorship, or issue a final research conclusion.
review_pack_title: DIO Sophia Research Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Research conclusions, factual verification, ethics approval, authorship, publication acceptance and final release remain with authorised researchers, reviewers, ethics bodies and publishers.
